name: Bellwater cistern, well end
notes: The well end of the cistern in the scene bellwater-priory (mw-e24.10), where the tunnel from the Glen Well comes in. The player-filtered volume `glen-well-cistern` covers the chamber round arrive-from-briar-glen-green: the first time the player stands in it the latch writes well.tunnel.found = true and keeps it, and the rumour book resolves rumour 4 (place-glen-well's visit trigger is this volume).
